title: AqSolDB structural coverage of the frozen ID5 neighborhood
scientific_question: Does the immutable AqSolDB source contain experimentally measured structural neighbors for the exact MOLDISC-001 seed and generated candidate set?

decision_rule.interpretation: The observed nearest-neighbor bins determine whether a later, separately frozen local-model experiment is scientifically worth opening; MOLDISC-002 itself does not train one.

interpretation_boundaries: AqSolDB measurements are experimental source records but heterogeneous across original protocols.
Structural similarity is not evidence of shared mechanism, binding, potency or efficacy.
MOLDISC-002 does not modify the closed MOLDISC-001 solubility result.
MOLDISC-002 does not train or select a new predictor.
Any local or AqSolDB-trained model requires a new protocol frozen before observing its performance.
